current_ontology_boundary: ontology_spec.yaml v0.1.4. ciroh:ComputationalModel (A-DOM03) is abstract: true, parent ciroh:SoftwareEntity. Concrete subtypes: A-DOM03a ProcessBasedModel, A-DOM03b ConceptualModel, A-DOM03c StatisticalModel, A-DOM03d MLModel. No concrete subtype covers an agent-based simulation model.
why_existing_classes_do_not_fit: Not ProcessBasedModel - does not represent physical/hydrologic/hydraulic/environmental processes. Not ConceptualModel - not a simplified conceptual storage structure. Not StatisticalModel - no named statistical model identity (A-DOM03c is vestigial per its status_note). Not MLModel - not data-driven or a trained architecture; the unit states deep RL is integrated into the ABM, which distinguishes them. ComputationalModel itself is not instantiable.

evidence_span.text: IAHS enables these community-based efforts by providing support and facilitation.

current_ontology_boundary: ontology_spec.yaml v0.1.4. A-AG02 Organization (schema:Organization) exists in the agent layer but is declared extraction: det with locus 'affiliation; awards[].funding_agency'. Its only relations are A-AG-R1 affiliatedWith (Person -> Organization), A-AG-R2 fundedBy (Paper/DatasetResource -> Award) and C-D09 fundedBy (DatasetResource -> [Award, Organization]), all deterministic and all outside the discourse layer.
why_existing_classes_do_not_fit: IAHS, the World Economic Forum and the UN appear in body prose as substantive agents - IAHS recommends foci and enables community efforts, the WEF classifies the water crisis as a top global risk, the UN hosts the aligned global agendas. None of these roles is affiliation or funding. Organization is not routed for LLM-extracted discourse units, and no routed node type (Concept, Background, Theme, ResearchProblem, ResearchGoal, ResearchSignificance, Method, Finding, Conclusion, Contribution, FutureWork, Claim) covers a named organization.

potential_relations_affected.missing_relation_shape: No relation connects Organization to a discourse unit or to a domain entity from publication prose. Expressing 'IAHS recommends Method X' or 'WEF classifies ResearchProblem Y' would require both prose-scoped Organization instantiation and a new relation signature.
potential_relations_affected.inheritance_note: Unlike the AgentBasedModel gap, this one is not resolved by adding a subtype: Organization already exists, but in a layer whose extraction mode and locus exclude body prose.
